ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 0.40:0.60 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white contiguous blobs located on the distal portions of both lobes; right lobe shows a more solid white terminal area than the left. Heavy salt-and-pepper mottling characterizes the transition zones between white distal areas and the solid low-intensity black central and lower fluke regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an internal vertex angle of approximately 55-60 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels along the span of both lobes; serrations are more pronounced and jagged on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex trajectory sweeping upwards from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast tan and white pixel clusters located on the extreme left distal tip; smaller, isolated circular white spots detected on the right distal edge and within the black pigmentation of the lower lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple short, vertical high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) detected in the mid-to-lower black pigmented quadrants of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant biological encrustation and structural irregularity on the superior corner of the left fluke tip, appearing as a brown/tan accumulation with associated tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation pattern where the white-to-black transition on the left lobe is significantly more mottled and extends further toward the midline than the corresponding region on the right lobe.
